description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of several large language models (LLMs) – TTS, Llama-2-3B-Instruct, Llama-1-1-405B-Instruct, ol-mini, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B, and ol – across six different evaluation tasks: MATH-500, AIME24, and four unnamed tasks labeled (a) through (f). The horizontal axis represents the model, with labels “3B”, “unk”, “405B”, “671B”, and “7B” denoting model sizes and “unk” indicating an unspecified configuration; the models are arranged in a consistent order across the tasks. The vertical axis represents the performance score, labeled with units, ranging from 0 to 100 with a tick interval of 10. Each task is represented by a set of six grouped bars, one for each model. Within each task, the bars are color-coded to represent the individual models as indicated in the legend. For example, in the MATH-500 task, the TTS model is represented by a purple bar with a height of approximately 95, while the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model is represented by a dark teal bar with a height of approximately 79.8. In task (d), the Llama-2-3B-Instruct model has a score of 30.0, while the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model has a score of 44.6. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
